summary: Iteration 21 (5 new features): full backend + frontend E2E. New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_phase_n_admin_emails_analytics.py = 11/11 PASS (admin order emails on POST /api/orders and /api/payments/razorpay/verify, 0-admin safety, ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_EMAILS schema+roundtrip, expanded /api/admin/analytics/summary keys + session attribution, queue_email mocked fallback, abandoned-cart sweep). Playwright: Instagram in-app-browser UA (iOS + Android) renders home fully, hero CTA navigates to /shop, mobile hamburger nav works, MusicWidget suppressed, scrollRestoration override skipped (stays 'auto'); Admin Orders item preview modal opens with image + qty/price/SKU/personalisation and closes; Admin Analytics renders all 6 new panels + Sessions/Pages-per-session/Bounce KPIs and reacts to range switch. Verified the real in-app scheduler autonomously fired an abandoned-cart recovery email 60s after boot (backend log + outbox, exactly one email per cart).

minor.issue: DEAD FEATURE: trackCart() is exported in frontend/src/lib/api.js but never called anywhere in the app, so abandoned_carts are never created by real shopper sessions -> the new abandoned-cart recovery scheduler can only ever fire on manually/admin-inserted carts. Also the endpoint is unauthenticated and accepts an arbitrary email, so the confirmed requirement 'abandoned-cart emails only for logged-in users' is not enforced (there is no customer auth in the app at all - only admin Emergent auth).

Bounce rate reads 0% on real data. Events without session_id are bucketed as 'anon-<YYYYMMDDHHMM>' so multiple distinct visitors in the same minute collapse into one 'session' (count>1 => never a bounce); combined with React StrictMode firing page_view twice per route in dev, every session has >=2 views so bounce_rate is structurally 0 and sessions/avg_pages_per_session are unreliable until session_id events dominate.

Fan-out is every db.admin_users doc with role='admin' (24 rows in this preview DB, many left over from earlier test iterations). Each order now queues 24+ outbox rows; when Gmail creds are set this becomes 24 real SMTP sends per order, serially inside the request path (await queue_email in a for-loop) which will slow POST /api/orders. Consider background task + dedupe/cap.

ui_bugs.issue: Hamburger buttons had no data-testid - added data-testid='nav-menu-btn' (mobile) and 'nav-menu-btn-tablet' (tablet) so IG-UA nav flows are testable

Order rows and the 'Details' button had no data-testid; added data-testid='order-row-{order_number}' and 'order-details-btn-{order_number}'. The item preview modal itself (order-item-row-N / order-item-preview / -image / -close) works correctly.

Clicking the backdrop centre cannot close the modal - the pointer-events wrapper (fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex ...) puts the modal card over the backdrop, so only the thin outer margin is clickable and no Escape handler exists. Close button works.

No data-testid on the Categories / FeaturedProducts sections (AboutStory=home-about and InstagramFeed=instagram-feed do have them), so section-level render assertions for the IG bug had to fall back to image/text probes.

integration_issues.issue: Two identical POST /api/analytics/track calls per route change (React.StrictMode double effect in dev). Harmless in a prod build but doubles page_views and zeroes bounce rate in this preview env.

design_issues.screen: Home hero (data cleanup, was breaking the storefront)
issues: Found 19 leftover TEST hero slides in db.hero_slides from earlier iterations (images pointing at https://cdn.example.com/TEST-M-*.jpg, empty headings, 'Slide-0/1/2'). Home showed a broken hero image + 20 carousel dots for every visitor including the Instagram UA runs. I deleted the 19 cdn.example.com slides; home now renders the real 'Share the Message of Love & Hope' slide with 0 broken images.

action_items: Wire trackCart()/POST /api/cart/track into the storefront (cart drawer / checkout email step) and gate it to authenticated shoppers, otherwise the abandoned-cart recovery feature never triggers in production and the 'logged-in users only' requirement is unmet (no customer auth currently exists).

Make the analytics session model robust: drop or narrow the 'anon-<minute>' session fallback (or ignore session-less events for bounce/session KPIs) and de-dupe repeated page_view posts for the same session+path so bounce rate / sessions / pages-per-session are meaningful.

Move admin order notification fan-out off the request path (asyncio task / background) and cap/dedupe recipients - 24 admins currently means 24 serial SMTP sends per order once Gmail creds are configured.
Optional UX: allow Escape / true backdrop click to close the Orders item preview modal.
Optional: add data-testid to Categories and FeaturedProducts home sections.
critical_code_review_comments: queue_email performs blocking SMTP inside a thread executor per recipient and is awaited inline in POST /api/orders; with N admins this multiplies checkout latency by N. Fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task or a queue worker.

_behaviour_stats loads every page_view document for the window into Python dicts (no aggregation pipeline, no limit). At real traffic volumes this will be slow/memory heavy - move to a $group aggregation.

_abandoned_cart_scheduler is correct and idempotent (recovery_email_sent guard verified: exactly one email per cart), but it never checks whether the cart belongs to a logged-in user, contradicting the stated requirement.
server.py is 4433 lines - well past the 700-line guideline; split routers (orders/payments/analytics/settings/email) into modules.

rca_of_the_issue: Instagram freeze bug: root cause was the unconditional window.history.scrollRestoration='manual' + hard scroll override plus the autoplaying MusicWidget fetch inside IG/FB WebViews. The isInAppBrowser() guard in index.js / ScrollToTop.jsx / MusicWidget.jsx fixes it - verified with real IG iOS and Android UAs: scrollRestoration stays 'auto', no music widget node, full render of hero/about/instagram sections, scrolling to 3500px and back works, hero CTA and hamburger navigation both reach /shop, zero page errors. Bounce-rate 0% RCA: session-less events are grouped per-minute ('anon-<minute>') and StrictMode double-posts each page_view, so every synthetic session has >=2 views and can never be counted as a bounce.
